research_goal: Understand how Singapore office workers choose a food-delivery app for weekday lunch, what would make them switch, and what keeps them loyal.
warmup_questions: To start, could you tell me what a typical weekday lunch looks like for you?
When did you last order food for delivery?
How often do you order lunch to your office or home?

topics.title: Choosing an app and a meal
questions: How do you decide which app to open when you want lunch delivered?
Could you walk me through the last time you picked a meal in the app?
How much do you compare apps before ordering?

must_cover.text: which apps they use and why
how delivery fees and promotions affect the choice
how long they are willing to wait
whether they compare apps before ordering

topics.title: The delivery experience
questions: What does a good delivery experience look like for you?
Has an order ever gone wrong?
How did the app or the rider handle it?

must_cover.text: what makes a delivery feel good
problems they have had and how they were handled
how much they use live order tracking
the role of the rider in how they feel about an app

topics.title: Switching and loyalty
questions: Have you ever stopped using a delivery app?
What would make you try a new delivery app?
What would it take for you to move to it for good?

must_cover.text: what made them stop using an app
what makes a new app trustworthy
views on paid subscriptions
using more than one app at the same time

topics.title: Paying and promotions
questions: How do you usually pay for a delivery order?
How do vouchers or promotions change what you order?
Do you order together with colleagues?

must_cover.text: preferred payment methods
use of vouchers and codes
ordering together with colleagues

topics.title: Food choices
questions: What kind of food do you usually order for lunch?
How do you decide between a familiar dish and something new?
How important are reviews and photos in the app?

must_cover.text: the kinds of food they usually order
willingness to try new restaurants
the role of ratings, reviews and photos

topics.title: Health and budget
questions: How do you think about health when you order lunch?
Do you set a budget for a delivery lunch?

must_cover.text: how health affects their choices
the budget they have in mind per meal

topics.title: Delivery and the working day
questions: How does ordering lunch fit into your working day?
What happens when you are too busy to order?
How do meetings or deadlines change what you do?

must_cover.text: how ordering fits into the working day
what they do on very busy days
delivery to the office building: pickup points and waiting

topics.title: What they would change
questions: If you could change one thing about delivery apps, what would it be?
What would a perfect lunch delivery look like?

must_cover.text: the one change they want most
their picture of an ideal service

hypotheses: Delivery fees matter more than meal price for the weekday lunch decision
Subscriptions lock users in more than promotions do
